styles.name: Cocoa detachable long strap for the cross-over bib apron — stud fastened, pair
styles.desc: Detachable long strap for the neck / waist tie of the cross-over bib apron OHAPP0535_ _ _ /__DS, sold and made in pairs · Top studs x 2 with 3 cm spacing set to one end of the strap, use the marker · Stitch side of the strap to the outside of the bib · Stud as pairs and keep together
styles.lectra: OHSTRAP, variant OHSTRAP — cut at 192 cm x 7 cm, one pair
fabrics: Cocoa 100% organic cotton 260 gsm X149ECO-AM307 (Tiajo) — rating 0.20 m per pair
trims: THREAD — COATS EPIC 80'S BROWN 08975 — cost per metre
Black Oliver Harvey logo'd non tangle tape, cut 39 cm, "Oliver Harvey" to read from top to bottom. One per pair.
Female part (socket), set to the strap with the marker: 2 per strap, 4 per pair. The male part is on the bib apron.
Red Oliver Harvey band around each rolled pair (no Sage code on the trims list).
mfg: Bag out both ends of the strap.
Enclose the raw edges and edgestitch the long edge.
Press to ensure there is no twisting of the strap and it lies flat.
fin: Set the top studs to the end of the strap, use the marker: centre of the first stud 1.5 cm from the end of the strap, 3 cm spacing measured centre to centre. Stitch side of the strap to the outer edge of the bib. Ensure the straps are studded as a pair and kept together. On the bib the centre of the top stud sits 1.5 cm from the side of the bib and 1.5 cm in from the top edge, second stud 3 cm spacing.
Roll up and put in pairs. Set a red Oliver Harvey band around them.
styles.note: Works order OHSTRAP Cocoa sheet (created JH 10/5/16; red band YL 14.11.17; fabric amended to X149ECO and care label updated JH 26/2/25). Quantities are in pairs. The sheet is in works-orders/OHSTRAP-straps.xlsx.
